messages:
elena: :rotating_light: Monitoring alert — eu-west-1: provisioning calls failing, control-plane returning 503s. ~40% of GPU pool reported unavailable.
ops-bot: Incident created: region=eu-west-1 severity=high tag=provisioning; alert_id=INC-1762559000
samir: On it. Quick question — is this cloud API rate-limiting or driver rollout in region? Can we shift new traffic to eu-central?
elena: Initial triage: cloud provider API 429s + timeouts during instance create; looks like a provisioning request spike after a driver rollout. Not a full zone drain but new instance creation is stalling. eu-central shows ~18% warm spare GPUs.
maria: CS: need a short status page blurb and targeted outreach to Dedicated customers in EMEA. Can someone draft?
elena: Draft status blurb:
"We are currently experiencing GPU provisioning failures in eu-west-1 impacting new GPU-backed sessions. New requests may fail or see elevated latency. We are shifting new traffic to eu-central to reduce failures. Impact: some existing sessions pinned to eu-west-1 may remain degraded until we complete a KV/session migration. ETA for new-request mitigation: ~30-45 minutes. Updates every 15 minutes."
Thoughts?
support-lead: Good. Two asks from CS: 1) ETA for migrating pinned sessions, 2) what to say about data/session continuity and SLA.
ian: Technical note: routing new requests to eu-central is fast (~10m), but pinned sessions (model KV + caches) won't move automatically. Migration requires KV resync and validation — estimate 2-3 hours for majority of sessions.
samir: I'll start a staged traffic shift: 20% -> 50% -> 80% while we watch latency and errors. Also enable soft rate-limit on low-priority routes to avoid queue spikes. Running: `rdw route set --region eu-central --weight 20 --policy staged`
elena: Kicking off 20% now. Monitoring KV miss rate and provisioning logs. Seeing repeated `autoscaler: create_instance timeout` and `provisioning: cloud api 429` in logs.
ops-bot: Status update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1762559000 (post id 9024)
elena: Traffic now at 50% to eu-central. New-request error rate down; steady-state latency near baseline. KV cache miss rate increased ~3x while warming. :white_check_mark:
samir: If cache misses stay high, enable prefix warmup and bump autoscaler target by 10% to pre-warm capacity.
ian: Doing autoscaler bump and starting prefix warmup. Watching queue length and CPU/GPU metrics.
elena: Autoscaler accepted bump; provisioning success rate improving (30% -> 72%). New instances come up in eu-central.
maria: CS pinged top affected accounts; one enterprise rep asked for a clear ETA for pinned-session migration and SLA credit path.
support-lead: Opening SLA ticket and looping legal. For public status we'll post elena's draft and call out ETA for pinned sessions separately.
elena: Honest status update for customers: migrating pinned sessions requires KV resync and careful validation. Safe ETA 2-3 hours for most sessions; very long-lived sessions may take longer. We'll post updates every 15 minutes and note progress on the status page. Next update in ~12 minutes.
